title: Sheng-Yun Brian Yu CV
subtitle: Tech Lead · 8 years in backend and platform engineering; led an 11-person cross-functional team; iterating faster with AI-assisted development

description.intro:
Hello, I am Sheng-Yun Yu (Brian Yu), a tech lead with around 8 years of experience. Node.js / TypeScript and NestJS on the backend, React / Next.js on the frontend, able to take a product line from schema design and APIs through the interface to deployment on my own.

At a gaming and live-streaming platform I moved from backend engineer to engineering manager, owning the microservice architecture, high-concurrency traffic, and the team's development standards.

What I have done with AI this past year: at Feeling Bank, working alone with AI agents, I delivered two product lines in six months (Bound built from scratch, Sugarbee taken over and maintained), shipped six Claude features, and launched on iOS and Android in about six weeks. At Pacificsmart, working with agents, I took the real-time AI interpretation platform Abestar Live from POC to production, and wired agents into the team's task dispatch, code review, and deployment, so a teammate can hand work to an agent by opening a card.

My approach is to write completion criteria as checks that run automatically, then let the agent iterate, which makes delivery faster while keeping a quality floor. When AI features go to production, I handle guardrails, fallbacks, offline evaluation, and cost accounting along with them.

I am seeking a tech lead or engineering manager role.
